purpose: Exploratory retrieval stress probes, not phishing gold or independent human benchmark.
split_limitations: Distinct input wording; source topics and some underlying claims shared. Not family-held-out generalization.
relevance_policy: A relevant summary supports the target claim, service and documented time scope. Generic topic similarity alone is insufficient. No-match can still have related background documents. Negative labels mean no supported target claim, not safe message.
selection_policy: Fixed BM25 1.2/0.75, E5-small and RRF60; top3; thresholds dev-only at >=90% dev hit; no test tuning.
source_id_reservation_note: Only document identifiers remapped 026..037 to 101..112 to reserve rejected v1 catalog IDs. Texts, claims, relevance decisions and split membership unchanged; early run inputs archived beside its predictions.
